name: Mass-Marketing and Advance-Fee Scams
description: Victims are lured by promises of prizes, inheritances, jobs or loans and asked to pay fees in advance. Scam networks operate across borders using mass communications and mule accounts.

sources.text: UK Finance, Annual Fraud Report (specify year, e.g. 2025)
FATF, guidance on proceeds of fraud (general)

indicators.ctx: Victim-side: repeated small payments for taxes, fees or insurance.
